title: System Administrator / Sistēmu administrators in Data Enablers team | SEB, Riga

summary.lv: SEB meklē Sistēmu administratoru Data Enablers komandā, kurš izstrādās un uzturēs ETL procesus SAP IQ, Apache Airflow un Nifi vidē, risinās incidentus un piedalīsies dažādos projektos.
summary.en: SEB is looking for a System Administrator to join the Data Enablers team, responsible for developing and maintaining ETL processes in SAP IQ, Apache Airflow and Nifi, handling incidents and participating in various projects.
